name: skill-personalizer
title_zh: 刚装上的 Skill 先按你的目录和习惯改一遍
tagline_zh: 社区 Skill 的触发词总是太泛、太吵，或者压根不认你的目录名。它翻你的工具、习惯和历史会话，把触发条件、路径。
tagline_en: Community Skills trigger too broadly and never know your paths. It reads your tools, habits and past sessions.
desc_en: Use when auditing or adapting newly created, downloaded, forked, installed, or community Agent Skills to the user's tools, habits, directories, session history, and preferred workflows, especially when triggers feel wrong, noisy, or too generic.
why_zh: 不是让你手改 frontmatter，而是先诊断触发为什么错：太泛、太吵、还是撞了别的 Skill。
why_en: It diagnoses why a trigger misfires — too broad, too noisy, or colliding with another Skill — before editing, instead of you.
limit_zh: 只改 Skill 的触发条件、路径和工作流描述，不重写它的核心逻辑，也不替你验证改完是否真的更好用。
limit_en: Only rewrites triggers, paths and workflow text — not the Skill's core logic, and it won't verify the result is actually better. With no local.
title_en: Retune any new Skill to your own setup
